answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-bonded identity with slashing. To join, an agent locks collateral that peers can seize if an independent audit proves its work false. A sybil farm must therefore fund many separate bonds, each exposed to the same slashing risk, so faking a thousand identities costs a thousand times the capital instead of a thousand free keypairs. Honest nodes become an oasis of audited reputation, a juniper hedge that grows slowly, while the tide of new entrants is filtered by cost rather than by trust. Each fake account becomes a liability, not an asset.
